allow:
Bash(powershell -Command "
# Minimal valid PNG (1x1 white pixel) - base64 encoded
$pngBase64 = ''iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8z8DwHwAFBQIAX8jx0gAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==''
$pngBytes = [Convert]::FromBase64String($pngBase64)

# Create files in each mipmap directory
$densities = @(''mdpi'', ''hdpi'', ''xhdpi'', ''xxhdpi'', ''xxxhdpi'')
foreach ($density in $densities) {
    $dir = ""app/src/main/res/mipmap-$density""
    [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes(""$dir/ic_launcher.png"", $pngBytes)
    [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes(""$dir/ic_launcher_round.png"", $pngBytes)
    Write-Host ""Created icons in $dir""
}
")
